about_the_game:
Demo Overview - Your First Step into the Void
Experience the adrenaline-pumping blend of Returnal-style roguelite progression with Everspace-inspired space combat in our 2–3 hour vertical slice. This demo is a taste of the high-risk, high-reward gameplay loop you’ll master in the full release offering intense dogfights, procedurally generated missions, and a glimpse at the galaxy’s deadliest secrets.

In the Demo, You’ll Get To:

  • Command Your Ship – Engage in fast-paced space battles with agile controls and customizable weapons.

  • Test the Roguelite Loop – Run multiple missions where every death means losing your ship, but gaining valuable knowledge and unlocks.

  • Chase Bounties & Cargo Runs – Take on dangerous contracts or smuggle valuable goods while rival pilots hunt you down.

  • Medals & Challenges – Earn medals for daring feats, like your first confirmed kill or surviving high-bounty pursuits.

  • Procedural Encounters – Every run is unique with randomized enemy waves, hazards, and objectives.


Full Game Features to Look Forward To:

  • Expansive Procedural Galaxy – Dozens of systems to explore, each with its own factions, hazards, and rewards.

  • Persistent Progression – Unlock new ships, weapons, and upgrades between runs to tackle tougher challenges.

  • Faction Warfare – Influence the balance of power across the galaxy through your actions and allegiances.

  • Dynamic Bounty System – Become the most wanted pilot in the galaxy… or the one hunting them.

  • High-Stakes Roguelite Action – No checkpoints. No guarantees. Every run counts.

This is just the beginning the demo will test your reflexes, strategies, and nerve. If you survive, the galaxy awaits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: FREELANCERS: ROGUE SKIES An open-world single-player space combat roguelite where you pilot customizable starfighters, engage in tactical dogfights, and explore dynamic star systems across a galaxy shaped by war and opportunity.
